design_finding: The inherited runner stops after three unavailable responses. The v5 written stopping rule omitted this active rule. Retain available rows, do not treat missing rows as failures, and require a separate approved continuation before more calls.
interpretation: OpenAI is a complete balanced matrix. Gemini is a late balanced partial matrix. Claude is an early partial matrix. Keep provider coverage explicit in every comparison.

ledger_recovery.role: model outcome, not an experiment-validity check

policy.primary: musical component accuracy on available responses
policy.provider_pooling: do not pool before provider results
